A ggplot2 theme in the spirit of Candido Portinari

Source: R/theme.R
theme_portinari.Rd

A complete ggplot2 theme that dresses a plot like one of Portinari's canvases: a warm ground of raw linen, firm drawn contours instead of a boxed panel, earth-colored lettering and an optional painted frame. Two further moods follow his United Nations panels: the deep indigo of Guerra and the golden light of Paz. Pair it with scale_color_portinari() and scale_fill_portinari().

Usage

theme_portinari(
  mood = c("canvas", "guerra", "paz"),
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "",
  grid = c("y", "x", "xy", "none"),
  frame = TRUE
)

Arguments

mood

The overall look. "canvas" (default) is a raw-linen ground with umber ink and sienna contours; "guerra" is a dark indigo ground with pale citrine ink and light blue contours; "paz" is a golden cream ground with brown ink and deep ochre contours.

base_size

Base font size, in points.

base_family

Base font family.

grid

Which major grid lines to draw: "y" (default), "x", "xy" or "none".

frame

If TRUE (default), draws a thin painted frame around the whole plot, like the edge of a stretched canvas.

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

Pairing palettes with a mood

The light moods share their ground with the lightest colors of several palettes (the creams of cafe and paz, the light centers of the diverging palettes, the pale ends of the sequential ones). That is natural for filled areas such as heatmaps, where the center then reads as neutral, but those colors fade when used for points or lines. The guerra mood uses the indigo that starts guerra and guerra_azul, so pair it with other palettes, for example paz or sofia: the ground of War with the colors of Peace.

See also

scale_color_portinari(), scale_fill_portinari()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_portinari("paz", name = "Cylinders") +
  labs(title = "Fuel economy", subtitle = "Heavier cars travel less per gallon") +
  theme_portinari()


ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = drv)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_portinari("sofia") +
  theme_portinari("guerra")


ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_portinari("roxa_terra", type = "continuous", direction = -1) +
  theme_portinari("paz", grid = "none", frame = FALSE)
